verdict.rationale: Treg is a tool catalog and credential proxy that external agents connect to via its CLI, MCP endpoint or llms.txt. Every use-case phrase ('give your agent...') refers to the user's own agent, and nothing in the pack documents a built-in AI assistant inside treg that users can delegate tasks to. A tool-gateway SaaS could plausibly ship one, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
